question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic cosecant function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcsch}⁡x)=-\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}\,[-2\operatorname{arcsch}⁡(\sqrt[4]{x})] \\  & =-2\cdot [-\frac{1}{|\sqrt[4]{x}|\sqrt{1+{(\sqrt[4]{x})}^{2}}}]\cdot {(\sqrt[4]{x})}^{′} \\  & =\frac{2}{\sqrt[4]{x}\sqrt{1+\sqrt{x}}}\cdot \frac{1}{4\sqrt[4]{{x}^{3}}} \\  & =\frac{1}{2x\sqrt{1+\sqrt{x}}}.\end{aligned}
$$
